judge.voice: Jo, Minecraft was good, and Mia was nice, short questions, no stress. I pressed Help three times and got the same long sentence, "My favourite block is..." — nevím what that means! The quiz was easier, I picked the house one. When I said "Já nevím" it told me "I don't know", okay, cool. But the next question about diamonds, I said nevím again, so did I learn it? Not really. Rex and football were fun, I could say that. I didn't like the list with booking and group project, that's homework. I'd use it for the dog talks, but I want help that gives me the word. Mum likes no trip to the club, ale nevím jestli se naučím víc.
